blocks.text: English
把日志用 HTTP POST 发到日志服务的输出插件，配合 `@migaia/log-host` 使用。本包每次交付只发一个请求；攒批、失败重试和超时由 host 的 Feature 提供，和其他输出共用同一套规则。

items: 每条日志一个请求，日志服务被打满：高峰时请求数和日志条数一样多。根因是没有攒批。
日志服务短暂 503，这段时间的日志全丢了：发送失败后没有重试，或者重试时无视服务返回的 `Retry-After`，把服务压得更死。根因是重试规则不区分错误类型，也不听服务端的节奏。

blocks.text: 下面注入一个假的 `fetcher` 代替真实网络：第一次返回 503，之后返回 200。用 Node 24 直接运行。
输出：

blocks.code:
第 1 次请求，带 2 条日志
第 2 次请求，带 2 条日志

blocks.text: 两条日志被攒成一个请求。第一次收到 503 后按 `retryFeature` 重试，第二次成功。`shutdown()` 等这一批送达后才完成。

rows: 默认 `globalThis.fetch`；接收 `(url, { method, headers, body, signal })`，返回带 `ok`、`status`、`headers.get` 的结果。超时和关闭通过 `signal` 传递
服务端 `Retry-After` 的上限，默认 30000

items: 请求体始终是 `{ "entries": [...] }`。每条 entry 的 `error` 用 host 的共享投影写出整条错误链（`source`、`code`、`name`、`message`、`stack`、`cause`、`errors`）。
HTTP 不消费格式化文本，host 的格式阶段对它跳过；在本插件的 `features` 里写 format 会在安装时被拒绝。
网络错误、429 和 5xx 可以重试，其他状态不重试；`attempts` 包含第一次请求。合法的 `Retry-After`（秒数或 HTTP 日期）覆盖普通退避间隔，并受 `maxRetryAfterMs` 限制。
没有 `retryFeature` 就不重试，没有 `batchFeature` 就不攒批，没有 `timeoutFeature` 就不另设超时。
没有任何可用 fetcher、`maxRetryAfterMs` 非法时，创建时同步抛出。运行期的发送和序列化错误进入 host 的失败通道，不让日志方法抛出、也不让 `flush()` 拒绝。错误域是 `logging.http`（`LOG_HTTP_ERROR_SOURCE`），错误码见 `LogHttpErrorCode`。
`features` 写成 `{ 名称: feature }` 记录；控制方法以 `http_<名称>_<方法>` 挂在 host 上。host 级默认策略和覆盖规则见 log-host 的组合策略。

blocks.text: 完整配置与错误边界见 使用指南。
安装本包与相同版本的 `@migaia/log-host`。每次 deliver 只做一次 POST；策略由 host feature 组合。
公开配置类型为 `IHttpPluginConfig`。url 原样传给 fetcher；缺省 fetcher 使用全局 fetch。注入函数接受 `(url, { method, headers, body, signal })` 并返回具有 ok/status/headers.get 的 Promise 结果。宿主超时和关闭通过 signal 传递；自定义 fetcher 应配合取消。
默认 Content-Type 为 application/json；headers 可覆盖，非空 authToken 再覆盖 Authorization 为 Bearer token。headers 在创建时复制。maxRetryAfterMs 默认为 30000，必须为有限非负数。

请求体始终为 `{ "entries": [...] }`。HTTP 调用 host 的共享 entry 投影；error 使用完整序列化错误链，保留 source/code/name/message/stack/cause/errors，排除 raw 和额外私有 Error 字段。普通业务字段保持原结构。HTTP 不消费格式化文本，跳过整个 host format 阶段；host 级 plain/pretty/JSON 格式不改变 wire。HTTP 的 output features 不能包含任何 format feature，否则创建时由 host 以 logging/INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。gate 与 entry 阶段照常执行。
网络错误、429 与 5xx 可重试，其它状态不重试。`attempts` 包含第一次请求。严格的 Retry-After 支持非负十进制秒数及三种 HTTP 日期；合法延迟覆盖普通 backoff 并按 maxRetryAfterMs 限制。没有 retryFeature 时不会隐式重试，没有 batchFeature 时不隐式聚合，没有 timeoutFeature 时不另设请求定时器。

`LOG_HTTP_ERROR_SOURCE` 为 logging.http；`LogHttpErrorCode` 包含 TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE、SERIALIZE_FAILED、DELIVERY_FAILED、INVALID_OPTION。缺少所有 fetcher、非法 maxRetryAfterMs 在创建时同步失败。运行期发送/序列化错误交给 host 失败通道，原生错误类型与 cause 保持可追溯；业务日志调用和 flush 不把交付失败重新抛出。交付失败与清理失败同时出现时，原交付错误排在错误链首位并用于重试分类；503 附带清理失败仍按配置重试。200 已成功而清理失败只报告一次 host 的 logging/DELIVERY_FAILED，不重发请求；timeout 自身错误也由 host logging 域负责。scheduler 必须在返回 receipt 之后才调用 callback。部署前应为 onFailure 提供业务需要的报告处理。
`features` 写成 `{ 名称: feature }` 记录；Feature 的控制方法以 `http_<名称>_<方法>` 挂在 host 上，例如名称为 `threshold` 时是 `http_threshold_setLevel`。host 级默认策略和覆盖规则见 log-host 的组合策略。
中文

An output plugin that sends logs to a log service with HTTP POST, used with `@migaia/log-host`. Each delivery sends one request; batching, retries and timeouts come from host Features and follow the same rules as every other output.

items: One request per log line overloads the log service: at peak, the request count equals the line count. The cause is no batching.

A short 503 from the log service loses every line sent meanwhile: failed sends are not retried, or retries ignore the service's `Retry-After` and pile more load on it. The cause is retry rules that do not tell errors apart or follow the server's pace.

blocks.text: The example injects a fake `fetcher` instead of a real network: the first call returns 503 and later calls return 200. Run it directly with Node 24.
Output:

blocks.code:
request 1 carries 2 entries
request 2 carries 2 entries

blocks.text: The two entries are batched into one request. After the first 503 the plugin retries under `retryFeature`, and the second attempt succeeds. `shutdown()` completes only after the batch is delivered.

rows: Defaults to `globalThis.fetch`; receives `(url, { method, headers, body, signal })` and returns a result with `ok`, `status` and `headers.get`. Timeouts and shutdown arrive through `signal`
Copied at creation; `Content-Type: application/json` by default
Upper bound for the server's `Retry-After`, 30000 by default

items: The request body is always `{ "entries": [...] }`. Each entry's `error` is written through the host's shared projection with the whole error chain (`source`, `code`, `name`, `message`, `stack`, `cause`, `errors`).
HTTP does not consume formatted text, so the host skips the format phase for it; a format in this plugin's `features` is rejected at install.

Network errors, 429 and 5xx can be retried; other statuses are not. `attempts` includes the first request. A valid `Retry-After` (seconds or an HTTP date) replaces the ordinary backoff and is capped by `maxRetryAfterMs`.
Without `retryFeature` there is no retry, without `batchFeature` no batching, and without `timeoutFeature` no extra timeout.

With no usable fetcher, or an invalid `maxRetryAfterMs`, creation throws synchronously. Send and serialization errors at run time go to the host's failure channel; log methods do not throw and `flush()` does not reject. The error domain is `logging.http` (`LOG_HTTP_ERROR_SOURCE`); see `LogHttpErrorCode` for codes.
`features` is a `{ name: feature }` record; controls appear on the host as `http_<name>_<method>`. For host-wide defaults and override rules see Composing policies in log-host.

blocks.text: See the usage guide for full configuration and error boundaries.
Install this module with the same version of `@migaia/log-host`. Each delivery makes one POST; host features supply transport policy.

The public option type is `IHttpPluginConfig`. The URL is passed unchanged to fetcher, which defaults to global fetch. An injected function accepts `(url, { method, headers, body, signal })` and returns a Promise of an ok/status/headers.get response. Host timeout and shutdown propagate through signal; custom fetchers should cooperate with cancellation.

Content-Type defaults to application/json. Custom headers can override it; a nonempty authToken then overrides Authorization with Bearer token. Headers are copied at creation. maxRetryAfterMs defaults to 30000 and must be finite and nonnegative.

The body is always `{ "entries": [...] }`. HTTP uses the host's shared entry projection: errors retain source/code/name/message/stack/cause/errors while raw and private Error fields stay off the wire. Ordinary business fields retain their structure. HTTP does not consume formatted text and skips the entire host format phase. Host plain/pretty/JSON formats do not change the wire. HTTP output features cannot include any format feature: the host rejects it at creation with logging/INVALID_OPTION. Gate and entry stages still execute.

Network failures, 429, and 5xx are retryable; other statuses are not. Attempts include the first request. Strict Retry-After supports nonnegative decimal seconds and all three HTTP date forms. A valid delay overrides normal backoff and is clamped by maxRetryAfterMs. Without retryFeature there are no hidden retries; without batchFeature there is no implicit batching; without timeoutFeature there is no separate request timer.

`LOG_HTTP_ERROR_SOURCE` is logging.http. `LogHttpErrorCode` contains TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE, SERIALIZE_FAILED, DELIVERY_FAILED, and INVALID_OPTION. Missing fetch capabilities and invalid maxRetryAfterMs fail synchronously at creation. Runtime delivery/serialization failures reach the host failure channel with native error types and reachable causes. Business log calls and flush do not rethrow delivery failures. When delivery and cleanup both fail, the original delivery error comes first in the error chain and drives retry classification. A 503 with cleanup failures still follows the configured retry policy. Cleanup after a successful 200 is reported once as host logging/DELIVERY_FAILED and never replays the request; timeout errors also belong to host logging. A scheduler must return its receipt before invoking the callback. Install the onFailure reporting behavior required by your application.

`features` is a `{ name: feature }` record; a Feature's controls appear on the host as `http_<name>_<method>`, for example `http_threshold_setLevel` for the name `threshold`. For host-wide defaults and override rules see Composing policies in log-host.

symbols.identity: packages/log-plugin-http/dist/error-code.d.ts:LogHttpErrorCode:export declare const LogHttpErrorCode: { /** No injected or host fetch capability exists; inject a fetcher before creating this output. */ readonly transportUnavailable: 'TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE'; /** JSON projection failed before any POST; inspect the original payload through cause. */ readonly serializeFailed: 'SERIALIZE_FAILED'; /** A POST rejected or returned a failed status; retry only according to the transport hint. */ readonly deliveryFailed: 'DELIVERY_FAILED'; /** Retry-After's admitted bound is negative or nonfinite; correct the factory option. */ readonly invalidOption: 'INVALID_OPTION'; };
